title: Enforce link expiry on every redirect, and add bulk create
goals: A link must stop redirecting as soon as it expires
Let a client create many short links in one request
functionalRequirements: A link that expires while it is cached must return 410 Gone on the next redirect
POST /api/v1/urls/bulk accepts 1 to 100 URLs and creates each independently
The response says, per item, whether it was created (with its code) or rejected (with the reason)
nonFunctionalRequirements: No change to the behaviour of existing endpoints
The new endpoint must not be a way around the per-client create rate limit
acceptanceCriteria: A cached link returns 410 the moment it expires, including exactly at its expiry instant
A link that has not expired keeps redirecting
A bulk request with valid and invalid items creates the valid ones and reports the invalid ones
An empty request and a request with more than 100 items are rejected with 400
Bulk requests count against the same per-client create limit
assumptions: A bulk request counts as one create for rate limiting
Partial success is acceptable: items are independent
